name: The Kings Arms

layers.essential_history: [[c:Polebrook is an old village: it appears in the Domesday Book as Pochebroc and was the centre of a large area called the Polebrook hundred.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:People have farmed around here since about 400 BC. Look for the war memorial on the main street, with a US flag honouring the airmen of the 351st Bomb Group.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The film crew's driver is frantic: a reel is missing from the van. Chalked on the van door is a message.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The chalk message]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Each letter has been moved one place along the alphabet. Move each one back a place.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where should you go first? (one word)]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:A chalk message on the van said CHURCH.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: the Kings Arms is the village pub.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south-east, about 130 metres as the crow flies, to the village hall. Walk along to the church end of the village. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
